description: Opera Neon, an agentic browser, through the installer Opera's site serves.
why: The bundle id is Opera Neon's only value on macOS, so must_find proves it; must_contain names it as well, so a second value added later cannot stand in for it. The other AI browsers are forbidden: a new Chromium fork must not be read as one already catalogued.
known_gaps: A match says Opera Neon is installed, not that Neon Do ran or a subscription is active: no route reads either.
The browser is stopped before the query, so no launchd or running-app value is read on macOS.
